history.summary: A 2015 freehold 2BR loft in Geylang/Aljunied (D14), 614 sqft at $780K / $1,270 psf, just 440m from Aljunied MRT. Low quantum, freehold tenure and a 5-min MRT walk make this an efficient, liquid entry-level investment — the standout score (684) here — though it's a small boutique loft block with Geylang-fringe stigma.
history.rating_rationale: $780K freehold 2BR at $1,270 psf is genuinely cheap for a transit-adjacent (440m Aljunied MRT) city-fringe unit — quantum sits in the most liquid entry band and 2BR has the widest tenant pool. score_1000 684 and on-frontier status confirm value. Caveats: no project URA series, small boutique loft development, and Geylang-fringe location stigma, but the price/transit/tenure combination is compelling.

history.summary: The algo's huge 'cheapness' is a data artifact: this 614sqft 'unit' is a penthouse duplex (560sqft + 54sqft loft) with no comparable cohort, so the -32.5% premium and very_low_psf flag are distortions. At ~$1,270 psf it's roughly at market for a FH Geylang-edge unit, not a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: The dossier's standout signals are quirks, not value. psf_cohort_txns=0 means there is NO same-size comparable, which is exactly why age_adj_premium reads an extreme -32.5% and the very_low_psf flag fires — the model is comparing a one-off lofted penthouse against the project pool. Web confirms the unit is a duplex: 560sqft living + a 54sqft loft, marketed as a 614sqft '2BR'. Against the actual project 12-mo transaction band of $1,304-$1,340 psf (avg ~$1,318), the $1,270 asking is only marginally below market — a real but small discount, and the loft layout (low ceiling, less usable) typically hurts both resale liquidity and rentability. Positives: freehold, 7-min walk to Aljunied MRT (EWL), and Lorong 24 sits at the edge of — not inside — the worst red-light stretch. appreciation_pct -0.09% over 21 txns shows no momentum either way. Net: a fairly-priced niche unit, not the bargain the score implies; thin/distorted data forces low confidence.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns=0 and very_low_psf flag are data artifacts — the -32.5% age-adj premium is NOT real cheapness
Unit is a penthouse duplex (560+54 loft), an illiquid niche layout that narrows the buyer/tenant pool
Lorong 24 Geylang — edge of red-light belt; some banks restrict financing in parts of Geylang, hurting resale liquidity
Only ~$50 psf below project average — not a meaningful discount once the artifact is stripped out
catalysts: Freehold tenure (no lease decay) — note v3.4 treats FH as no forward edge, just a hold-quality positive
7-min walk to Aljunied MRT (EWL); ~13 min to Dakota (CCL) — reasonable connectivity
D14 strong rental yields (3.5-4.5%) and en-bloc optionality on small FH Geylang plots over the long run
